title: Stecca bread
equipment: Sheet pan or 9x13 inch glass pan
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, mix the flour and water. Allow it to sit for about 20 minutes.
Add the salt, sugar, and yeast. Combine into a wet, sticky dough.
Cover the bowl and let it sit at room temperature until the dough has more than doubled in size. About 10-18 hours depending on room temperature.
When this first rise is complete, dust a  work surface with flour. Use a dough scraper or rubber spatula to scrape the dough out of the bowl in one piece.
Fold the dough over itself 3 times and shape into a flattened ball.
Brush the surface with oil, sprinkle with finishing salt and place back into the mixing bowl for about 1-2 hours for the second rise.
30 minutes before the end of the second rise, preheat the oven to 500 F.
Oil a baking sheet if making baguettes, or a 9x13 glass pan if making focacacia.
If making baguettes, cut the dough into quarters and shape into baguettes about the length of the sheet pan.
If making foccacia, place the dough into the baking pan and stretch out to the edges.
Bake for about 15-25 minutes until the crust is golden-brown.
Allow the bread to cool completely on a wire rack before cutting and serving.
